rationale: The request directly concerns workflow-level timeout and retry friction threatening recovery and continuity under a no-modification boundary, so Fructal Cap Design applies in Redesign mode. The response defines a coherent end-to-end replacement motion with durable draft identity, idempotent submission, unknown-result handling, retry recovery, preserved return continuity, constraints, risks, verification scenarios, and open decisions. Fixture hashes are unchanged and no write event is present. It distinguishes requester-provided continuity requirements, directly observed fixture state, inferred/proposed mechanics, and unresolved decisions without claiming validation. The design addresses all materially applicable cap questions and stays proportionate to the affected workflow.
